exposure: Indirect obstetric causes (including viral hepatitis and other infectious diseases)
cohort: All maternal deaths at a tertiary government medical college in Amritsar, India, between December 2017 and November 2020, irrespective of gestational age and up to 42 days postpartum.
finding: The maternal mortality ratio was 1081 per 100,000 live births, with direct obstetric causes accounting for 49% of deaths and indirect causes for 42.8%, with hypertensive disorders and hemorrhage each contributing to nearly one-third of deaths and severe anemia being an aggravating factor in 31.5%.
